text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京分别会见来华工作访问并出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨，来华出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的老挝副总理兼外长通沙万和缅甸国家计划、投资与对外经济部部长昂觉霍。（央视）
text_en: On the 3rd in Beijing, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, separately met with Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak, who was in China for a working visit and to attend the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting; Lao Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Thongsavanh, who was in China for the meeting; and Myanmar's Minister of Investment and Foreign Economic Relations Aung Kyaw Ho. (CCTV)
